# Ian Cavanaugh

> Systems over spreadsheets.

Ian Cavanaugh is a sales engineer and systems designer working in industrial manufacturing. His background is in Naval Architecture and Marine Engineering (Webb Institute) — a discipline built on cross-disciplinary systems integration. That foundation has carried across industries: from maritime into HVAC, and from HVAC into the software that runs around it.

His career sits at the overlap of technical sales and software architecture. The recurring pattern in his work: find the process held together with Word documents and institutional memory, then build what should replace it.

## Work

Ian built an estimating pipeline from scratch in a single quarter — three layers of automation (takeoff ingestion, pricing engine, browser-based proposal dashboard) running on AWS. Job coverage went from 14% to 56% in the first week it ran.

He also built a browser-based on-screen takeoff tool for reading HVAC floor plans: a custom canvas engine with AWS Cognito, DynamoDB, and S3 for auth, storage, and persistence.

Earlier in his career he maintained production VBA tooling for years before leading its migration to Python — a case study in understanding legacy systems from the inside before designing what replaces them.

## Credentials
